schema_note: schema 2: one array per decision under its family's key legend (families.<family>.keys, a trailing run of nulls trimmed). Fields: game_pk (key into games, whose entry is [date (local, from the feed's first play), opponent, home as 1/0]), ab, idx (event index in the plate appearance, -1 for a play-result decision; the decision id is game_pk:ab:idx), half (0 top, 1 bottom), inning, outs, base (three-bit code: 1 first, 2 second, 4 third), score_diff (the deciding club's lead before the play), li (MLB feed leverage index; null on the leadoff plate appearance), kind (index into kinds; absent when it equals the family), in_id / out_id / pitcher_id / due_id / ondeck_id (the names table keys them; a row carries ids only), slot, pos, mwpa (wins, realized value, not skill: the window's endpoint difference in win probability, sign to the deciding club), dvs (wins above the matched-state league baseline; null in a thin cell), flags (indexes into flags), window (the plays governed, each [event index into events, wp_after] or [event, wp_after, wp_before] where the feed's chain breaks, the first play always carrying wp_before, wp in percentage points; the play's ab is the row's ab plus its offset; win_len is the window's length, 0 for a counted family). Family extras ride beside: pitch_count and tto of the removed pitcher, inherited runners and inherited_scored (derived), first_pa_mwpa, walk_only_mwpa, the steal's model dv / er / realized_delta beside the feed's mwpa, the bunt's league dv_cell beside its realized figure.

legend.row: one array per decision under families.<family>.keys; a trailing run of nulls is trimmed; the family is the block key
legend.names: player id -> name; rows carry ids only (in_id, out_id, pitcher_id, due_id, ondeck_id)
legend.window: [event, wp_after] or [event, wp_after, wp_before] where the chain breaks (the first play always carries wp_before); a fourth element, if present, is the play's ab where it is not the row's ab plus the offset
